title: Etching glass in the early Universe: Luminous HF and H<SUB>2</SUB>O emission in a QSO-SMG pair at z = 4.7
question: Do HF J=1-0 and para-H2O (2_20-2_11) trace outflows and energy dissipation in the QSO and SMG of BR 1202-0725 at z=4.7?

what.value: Herschel HF and H2O line fluxes and LIR for local AGN galaxies

evidence.quote: we extracted the HF emission line fluxes from local galaxies observed with Herschel in the sample of (cite: yang13)

what.value: CO(2-1) line widths at various beam sizes (VLA)

evidence.quote: we compare all of the line widths of CO(2–1) with restoring beam sizes of $\ensuremath{\lesssim}$0.6$''$ from (cite: jones16)

what.value: [CII] redshift and line width of the SMG

evidence.quote: we constrained this to the \[CII\] redshift (cite: carilli13)

what.value: Dust temperature of 43 K, SFR ~1e3 Msun/yr, CO models

evidence.quote: The estimated temperature of the dust continuum is about 43 K (cite: salome12).

recipe.method: Supplied calibration script in CASA; continuum model subtraction then linear fit of line-free channels; natural weighting
Point-source fit to continuum; Gaussian fit to H2O and HF lines
RADEX models to match HF brightness temperature, source size = beam
key_parameters: N(HF)=1e15 cm-2, n_H2=1e5 cm-3, Tgas=43 K, Tbg=15.5 K, ne=10 cm-3, turbulent dispersion 5 km/s
assumptions: Turbulent velocity dispersion of 5 km/s as in Orion Bar

recipe.goal: Bootstrap HF absorption in SMG and outflow rate limit
recipe.method: 1000 realizations of data binned by 10 to 60 km/s; optical depth integrated over 0 to -400 km/s; Neufeld relation for N(HF); wind rate Mdot=pi m_H2 N(H2) V R
assumptions: All HF in ground state; HF abundance 3.5e-8

answer_key.quantity: Total molecular column from HF assuming solar F

evidence.quote: then the total molecular column is $\sim$10$^{22}$ cm$^{-2}$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges used for continuum fitting
Image size, cell size, and CLEAN threshold/masking
Flux calibrator and flux scale uncertainty
Spectral resolution/channel width of line cubes
Exact LIR values and adopted sources for the L_HF/L_IR plot
Full RADEX grid and fit procedure for brightness temperature matching
missing_for_reproduction: Literature L_IR values and HF fluxes for comparison sample
score_reason: Public data and simple fits, but imaging and modelling details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple Gaussian fits and numeric results in Table 1; imaging details partly missing.
